tour.title: Check this job
tour.body: Twelve synthetic branches over three weeks with a $180,000 ceiling. The gap analysis is provisional and shows anything unknown, before any partner signs up.

tour.title: Read a quote PDF
tour.body: Load the scanned Redwood quote, then press Read document. Each proposed fact keeps its page, line and exact words. A "2-man crew" is never read as capacity, and nothing changes until you choose readings to use.

tour.title: The cheap plan fails
tour.body: Alder + Redwood costs $156,000, but the independent checker fails weeks 1 and 2 on capacity. A failed candidate is never called impossible.

tour.title: Baseline plan passes
tour.body: Alder, Birch and Cedar: $168,000 with 4 / 4 / 4 sites per week. Every rule passes, and headroom is never shown as profit.

tour.title: Ask each partner privately
tour.body: Create a private link for each partner and share it yourself; creating a link does not send it. Then use "Sign in as this partner" on a card to confirm as Alder, Birch and Cedar.

tour.title: A customer change arrives
tour.body: The customer asks to move S09 and S10 into week 1. It is saved apart from the plan, then opened as a preview: the load becomes 6 / 4 / 2 with a two-slot gap in week 1.

tour.title: Repair with Dogwood
tour.body: Dogwood takes S09 and S10 for $172,000, and the plan passes again. The diff shows Alder changed, Dogwood new, and Birch and Cedar unchanged.

tour.title: Select the revised terms
tour.body: Selecting keeps the old terms and answers as history. Birch and Cedar carry over only if their terms are unchanged and still valid. Alder and Dogwood must review again.

tour.title: History is the receipt
tour.body: Open History in the header for every change and response, or the printable summary for a dated record of checks, contributions, exact responses and open conditions. Reset my demo copy starts over without touching anyone else.
